payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the development of the conceptual model in Figure 2, specifically through thematic analysis and participant feedback.

claims.text: The conceptual model in Figure 2 was developed using thematic analysis, which involved identifying and organizing themes from focus group discussions (FGDs) with participants.
The themes identified through the FGDs included gameful experience, social influence, intrinsic motivation, and extrinsic motivation, which contributed to the conceptual model.
The authors suggested that the model could be tested using quantitative methods to further validate the findings from the thematic analysis.
